items.q: How does the free trial work?
items.a: You get 5 AI generations completely free — no credit card required. Each generation produces a full piece of content. After 5 generations, you can upgrade to any paid plan starting at $9/month.

items.q: Can I cancel at any time?
items.a: Yes. Cancel anytime from your account settings. You keep full access until the end of your current billing period. No cancellation fees, no questions asked.
QUILL AI supports 10+ languages including English, German, Spanish, French, Italian, Portuguese, Dutch, Polish, Japanese, and Chinese. Starter and above unlock all languages.

items.q: Is the generated content unique and original?
items.a: Yes. Every piece is freshly generated for your specific topic and context — it's not recycled from a template. We recommend reviewing content before publishing for best results.
One click of the 'Generate' button counts as one generation, regardless of the length of the output. Copying, saving, or downloading your content is always free.
Absolutely. If you're not satisfied within 14 days of your first paid subscription, contact us and we'll issue a full refund — no questions asked.
